description: Starts signing the developer in to Builder (OAuth 2.0 authorization code with PKCE, redirecting to a localhost port this server opens) and returns at once without waiting for them: `{ status: "PENDING", signInUrl, browserOpened, reason?, expiresAt }`. It tries to open signInUrl in their browser; `browserOpened` says whether that worked and `reason` why not. Always give the developer signInUrl and ask them to open it in a browser on this machine. When browserOpened is false, end your turn after sharing it — nothing happens until they open it. Then call `wait_for_sign_in` to confirm. The link expires after 5 minutes; calling again while one is pending returns the same link. On success the token is saved in ~/.reclaim/config.json with mode 0600, refreshed automatically, and never returned. It authorizes organization-management tools such as `list_orgs`. Programmatic verification tools use a separate organization key; see `issue_org_token`. Call with no arguments.
name: reclaim_authenticate
